newsitem.title: USA: Midland Resources has new field find.
newsitem.headline: Midland Resources has new field find.

text.p: Midland Resources Inc said Monday it participated in the discovery of a new field in the Fusselman formation with estimated gross potential reserves of some nine million barrels of oil equivalent.

In a 24 hour test, the Sugg 1 exploration well flowed at a rate of 407 barrels of oil and 50,000 cubic feet of natural gas with a flowing tubing pressure of 250 pounds per square inch through a 13/64 inch choke.
Midland Resources said it owns a 50 percent working interest and a 43.75 percent revenue interest in the well, which was placed on production immediately following the test.
The company said it will proceed within two weeks with development drilling in the newly discovered field located in Reagan, Sterling, and Tom Green Counties, Texas.

Noting the discovery well location was selected based on interpretation of 3D seismic data obtained in late 1996, Midland said reprocessing of the data with the new information gained from the discovery well confirms the potential to drill up to 12 additional wells.

It said full development of the field could potentially add 3.3 million net barrels of oil equivalent to its oil and natural gas reserve estimates with 33 percent of those reserve estimates categorized as proved with successful completion of the Sugg 1. ((-- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.))
